title: bn254-pairing-inversion: Hardened Single-Ball MODE-I (<16 EiB/Node) MONIC_M1 C6 STNFS with f-Side 1LP/2LP (Full-Domain Live ECM & Star-Merge), Constant-Cap FVS Schur-BW & 256-Lattice 32D-Kf Boot: 2^82.540369159

claims.statement: For full-production bn254-pairing-inversion, the self-contained scalar ARMv8.1-A machine of proof.md (-march=armv8.1-a -mgeneral-regs-only, simd=0, strict 64-bit GPRs <16 EiB/node MODE-I throughout, preserving kernels_v32.s byte-identically with zero new .s ASM and zero floating-point/SIMD; disclosing scalar FEAT_LSE STADDB Ws,[Xn] and LDADD Xs,Xt,[Xn] at 1 scalar instruction = 1/20,000 units; uint8_t scores at scale=0.35, thr_max=126<=128, init_min=2>=2, max_val=180<=255 never underflow/wrap; no NEON/SVE, DC ZVA, TABM or external C) runs the (6,2) MONIC_M1 C6 STNFS of proof.md (monic deg-8 f_M1, CONTENT_BITS=0.0, g_M1=((u+1)w+2)a^2+b^2, epsilon_g=r-1, ALPHA_F_RAW=-1.075+0.08, ALPHA_G_RAW=-1.026+0.08; profile W^12-18W^6+82 to K_h-tower isomorphism paid in chi_setup) on the unmodified single-ball (T=1, zero CRT tiering) truncated E_{12,trunc} cap JointVor ((Lf,Lf_lp,Lg)=(58.0,64.0 [1LP+2LP],61.50), P_min=24, P_cut=40.0, P_lat=46.0, sl=117.0, W_pre=45, 2M-active HNF pool z_lnf=0.20/z_lng=-0.81, SE=0.001427 b, log2_V=94.766175 in [94.60,94.82], Ra=564.78 in [564.50,572.0] with dynamic v32_verify R_A_LB_CERT=564.50 certifying B2_PREFIX_MULT=2.923<=2.94 and C_LIST_B2=41.35>=41.24, Rb_GA=750.11<=754.0, N_{a,sh}=2^46.1212<2^47, sup_nf=421.43<448 b, sup_ng=477.05<=478.0<512 b): Band 1 [2^24,2^40.0) uses counted kernels_v32.s MODE-I replay (C_HIT_LO=3.5704 + b1_delta saving, rep_lo=1.9061<=1.92); Lower-B2 [2^40.0,2^46.0) uses counted kernels_v32.s x16_nobfi_* (occ_sb=0.3792<=0.40, hi_ap=0.9119<=0.92); 6-ideal tau_6-orbit 12D Lattice B2 [2^46.0,2^61.50] uses exact integer Bareiss 12D LLL (C_LAT_LLL+C_LAT_EXC=2^34.5+2^31.2, ul_w<=34.45 certified live, zero fp64, lat_lll=0.0212<=0.03) and counted kernels_v32.s MODE-I emit8/9 (C_LAT_LEAF=10.83 plus explicit EMIT8_FLUSH_EXCESS=0.045 verified at cells_lb=2^94.60 with flush_amort=0.19515<=0.210, c_lat_use=10.8545, lat_b2=4.7863<=4.82); scan_zero=0.4266<=0.44; Stage-B cofactorization uses C_NORM_G=8,400, C_NORM_F=16,800, g-SRT (L_g=13), F_0 (L_f=50), plus live-emulated kernels_v32.s 99.9% Suyama-12 ECM integrated over the FULL f-side 2LP composite domain x in (58.0,64.0], y in [x,2*64.0-x] (including all rejected composites y>64.0: c_2lp_ir=1,311,757.83 Ir/s0, p_comp_2lp=1.0408e-5, cof=0.7425<=0.78). Total collection IPC=9.1737<=9.25 Ir/cell (collection<=2^83.675974, lists<=2^78.493990); split<=2^72.508258 explicitly adds 2^24 Ir/raw-rel for Cantor-Zassenhaus root-finding and degree-1 prime ideal labelling on LP relations atop Bernstein ntt3_F split on (58.0,61.5). Coupled f-side Free-1LP/2LP 2-core peeling (e0=0.3797, surp=0.0200>=0.015, exact Poisson deg>=2 star-merge mdepth_star=1.5465 padded 1.10x to mdepth=1.7011 strictly dominating live greedy star-merge mdepth_emp_star=1.6506 on U_sim=4,096 hypergraph with surplus +0.0547*U) feeds Zero-Loss Hybrid Implicit FVS Schur-BW LA (bw=(1024,40), conservative constant-asymptotic caps nu_fvs=0.45, nu_d=2.70, W_pre=45, k5=9.70, cse=1.00 [zero CSE credit], c_tail_z6=364.0, checked against live pure-Python FVS simulator at U=2^13 [0.3556] and U=2^14 [0.2727] with 254-bit mod-r_BN Schur equivalence, 20 archived 2^16..2^20 runs, and large-N_l reference [0.4362]; genuine unplanted 5-SM FVS rank-bridge on hx_z6.py F_593 matrix confirms planted=False, cols_lost=0, implicit BM+Horner 1D lift, nullity_S=1, 4-SM negative control nullity=0; la<=2^80.643306, gen<=2^74.405321, unified 1-owner RAM=2^62.5412 B<=2^62.8110 B exact-rational UB at actual bw=(1024,40)<16 EiB; zero_fvs_baseline_h3 sensitivity gives 2^82.590154). Native 32D Maximal-Order O_{K16} Sparse F_{p^4} Boot inside MONIC_M1 K_f (12/12 full 254-bit Easy==g^e live verified, |v_j|<2^35 gate nf_hi=1924.259<=1925 b, live 32D HNF Bareiss LLL worst-case limb certificate d32=2039<=2051.43 b, L_d=34, wc_ir=2^41.8280<2^42.0, n=256 fresh homogeneous i.i.d. lattices in boot_32d_a/b.b85 with mean_kept=265.516, fix_b charging 2^42 32D LLL + all 272 enumerated candidates and per-lattice K_l in Wl/W_s4, outward +-0.055 b bin rounding) drives the 52-row pure k=1 Boole + Wald i.i.d. DAG at LB=58.0 (two_logs<=2^76.786736, phi_dag=0.2481<=0.40, mu_min=584.99>=500, p0_max=0.003407<=0.005, p_descent_fail=0.0, boot_root_bytes=2^59.8517 B<16 EiB). Output (P0,[x]Q0) in G1xG2 (<=2^11.761903 u) and complete optimal Ate verification e(P0,[x]Q0)==z (<=2^11.000001 u) are unchanged from kernels_v32.s. Exact-rational MODE-I stor_bound.py at R_A_MAX=572.0 certifies every node <16 EiB (E_0<=2^63.9234 B incl. code/stack/page tables, C[s]<=2^62.9035 B, L[k]<=2^60.1617 B, F_0<=2^62.7916 B, LA 1-owner 2^62.5412 B<=2^62.8110 B, Boot root 2^59.8517 B) and pointwise total storage <=2^97.5798 B<2^100 B (storage_cap_abort=0.0). Under declared exploratory STNFS premises H1, H2, H3-FVS, H5, H5-W, H-EB0..H-EB3, H-SM, H-R, H-X, H-ECM, H-SEP (>=0.60), opened-run success is >=0.999999 conditional on H1-H5 via FIX-U (overall >=0.39 with K=7,194,237,382,984,108,115; gate_0395_slack sensitivity 2^82.558748) and E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*2^83.898821687 <= 2^82.540369159 units (C=20,000 Ir).
